title: ohho.sweep/v1
description: Search space for an OhhO training sweep. Each trial recipe is the opaque base recipe plus dotted path=value overrides (the form ohho train --set uses). The recipe mapping is not validated here; its schema is a separate contract. Semantic rules enforced by ohho.train.sweep.validate_sweep in addition to this document: dimension names are unique; dimension paths are unique; high is greater than or equal to low; an int bound or step is an integer; float and log_uniform ranges with n greater than 1 have high greater than low; at most one objective is primary; strategy random, tpe, bayesian, or multi with at least one dimension requires budget.max_trials; strategy tpe and strategy bayesian (the built-in Tree-structured Parzen Estimator) require an objective and, when more than one objective is set, a primary; strategy multi (multi-objective TPE) requires at least two objectives; a grid float or log_uniform dimension without values requires n; an int n must yield that many strictly increasing points. estimated GPU-hours are an estimate computed from per-trial values in this spec. early_stopping.rule is patience (default), asha, or median. rule asha requires a non-empty rungs array. rungs are strictly increasing and each rung is greater than or equal to grace_period. asha keeps the best floor(n/reduction_factor) trials at a rung once n is at least reduction_factor. median stops a trial that is strictly worse than the median at that step once reduction_factor trials have reported it, and not before grace_period.

seed.description: Sweep seed. It derives the sampler seed and each trial's training seed. Grid order does not use it. random, tpe, bayesian, and multi draw proposals from the derived sampler seed.

strategy.description: grid expands the cartesian product. random draws budget.max_trials trials from seed. tpe and bayesian are the built-in Bayesian sampler (Tree-structured Parzen Estimator); bayesian selects that sampler by name. multi is multi-objective TPE and records a Pareto set for the leaderboard.

sampler.description: Knobs for tpe, bayesian, and multi. grid and random ignore them. startup_trials are random draws before the Parzen estimator is fit. gamma is the fraction of completed trials treated as good. candidates is how many draws from the good density are scored per proposal. prior_weight keeps a wide prior in the density.

parallelism.description: How many trials a later runner may execute at once. Plan does not launch them.

recipe.description: Opaque base recipe mapping. ohho.sweep/v1 copies it and applies dotted overrides. It does not interpret recipe fields.

earlyStopping.description: Stopping rule for intermediate metrics. The trial runner reports the metric at a step. The sweep controller calls decide, which returns continue or stop. patience stops one trial after this many reports without an improvement of min_delta. asha is successive halving at rungs. median stops a trial that is strictly worse than the median of trials that have reported that step. This object does not change which trials the sampler proposes. Stopped trials are marked pruned, which is distinct from failed.

metric.description: Name of the scalar the trial runner reports at each step.

rule.description: patience uses patience and min_delta on one trial. asha keeps the top floor(n/reduction_factor) at each rung once n >= reduction_factor. median compares the trial with the median at that step once reduction_factor trials have reported it.

rungs.description: Strictly increasing steps where a decision is made. Required and non-empty for rule asha. For patience and median, an empty or omitted list means every reported step can decide. Each rung must be >= grace_period.

reduction_factor.description: ASHA reduction factor (eta). Median stopping uses it as the minimum number of reports at a step before a trial can be stopped. patience ignores it.

grace_period.description: Do not stop a trial before this step. Rungs must be greater than or equal to this value.

patience.description: For rule patience, stop after this many decision-step reports with no improvement of at least min_delta.

min_delta.description: For rule patience, an improvement must be strictly better than the best value by this amount. mode min wants a smaller number. mode max wants a larger number.

mode.description: min treats a smaller metric as better. max treats a larger metric as better.

max_trials.description: Keep this many trials after constraints. Required for strategy random, tpe, bayesian, and multi when dimensions is non-empty.

max_gpu_hours.description: Stop before the next trial would push the estimated total above this value.

estimate.description: Per-trial GPU-hour estimate. The first matching by_value rule wins. Otherwise gpu_hours_per_trial is used. The total reported by the plan is an estimate computed from these values.
